legend-creole-nature-trail.slogan: Creole Nature Trail – a named road, mapped from its own anchor points
legend-creole-nature-trail.story: All-American Road. bayous, Gulf coast, wildlife. From Lake Charles it runs 183 km to Lake Charles; allow about 3 h 20 of riding. It goes by way of Sulphur, Cameron and Creole Nature Trail. The line favours views over speed.

scenicChapters.title: Creole Nature Trail
scenicChapters.narrative: Expect company on a summer weekend. Early is better than fast. For 15 km this is Creole Nature Trail, a road with a name of its own and a reason for it.
